## Checklist

- [ ] Commit subject is a Conventional Commit and reads as release-note text
      (it becomes one)
- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] `make lint` passes
- [ ] A behaviour change has a test that fails without it
- [ ] I did not touch `version.txt` or create a tag (release-please owns both)
